questions.question: In the parallel RLC circuit capacitor has initial voltage of $10\text{V}$ and at the same instant current through inductor is zero. At time$=0$ suddenly current source of $I(t) = 10e^{-5t} \text{ A}$ is applied across them having $R=10\ \Omega$, $L=10\text{ mH}$ and $C=1\ \mu\text{F}$. Using Laplace transform method, find voltage across node for $t > 0$.
